public reader reads published content.name: public reader reads published content
public reader reads published content.using:
exists (
        select 1
        from "app"."content_localizations" as localization
        where localization."document_id" = "app"."content_documents"."id"
          and localization."published_revision_id" is not null
          and localization."published_at" is not null
      )

web runtime reads published content.name: web runtime reads published content
web runtime reads published content.using:
"app"."content_documents"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid
        and (
          exists (
            select 1
            from "app"."content_localizations" as localization
            where localization."document_id" = "app"."content_documents"."id"
              and localization."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid
              and localization."published_revision_id" is not null
              and localization."published_at" is not null
          )
          or exists (
            select 1
            from "app"."content_preview_grants" as preview_grant
            where preview_grant."document_id" = "app"."content_documents"."id"
              and preview_grant."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid
              and preview_grant."session_token_hash" = nullif(current_setting('app.preview_token_hash', true), '')
              and preview_grant."consumed_at" is not null
              and preview_grant."expires_at" > now()
          )
        )

content_documents_page_kind_bounded.value:
"app"."content_documents"."page_kind" is null or (

        and "app"."content_documents"."page_kind" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$'
      )

"app"."content_localizations"."organization_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '')::uuid and nullif(current_setting('app.membership_role', true), '') in ('owner', 'editor')
        and exists (
          select 1
          from "app"."content_documents"
          where "app"."content_documents"."id" = "app"."content_localizations"."document_id"
            and "app"."content_documents"."organization_id" = "app"."content_localizations"."organization_id"
            and "app"."content_documents"."kind" = "app"."content_localizations"."kind"
        )
        and (

            "app"."content_localizations"."published_revision_id" is null

          or exists (
            select 1

            where revision."id" = "app"."content_localizations"."published_revision_id"
              and revision."document_id" = "app"."content_localizations"."document_id"
              and revision."locale" = "app"."content_localizations"."locale"
              and revision."published_at" is not null
          )
        )

content_preview_grants_path_safe.name: content_preview_grants_path_safe
content_preview_grants_path_safe.value:
char_length("app"."content_preview_grants"."path") between 1 and 240
        and left("app"."content_preview_grants"."path", 1) = '/'
        and left("app"."content_preview_grants"."path", 2) <> '//'
        and strpos("app"."content_preview_grants"."path", chr(92)) = 0
        and "app"."content_preview_grants"."path" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

content_preview_grants_consumption_bound.name: content_preview_grants_consumption_bounded
content_preview_grants_consumption_bound.value:
(
        "app"."content_preview_grants"."consumed_at" is null
        and "app"."content_preview_grants"."session_token_hash" is null
      ) or (
        "app"."content_preview_grants"."consumed_at" is not null
        and "app"."content_preview_grants"."session_token_hash" is not null
        and "app"."content_preview_grants"."consumed_at" >= "app"."content_preview_grants"."created_at"
        and "app"."content_preview_grants"."consumed_at" < "app"."content_preview_grants"."expires_at"
      )
